rule: Cutscene actions carry a start offset in client frames; once playing, a cursor fires every due action and stops at the first future one. The cutscene does not start until all entities, music actions and objects report ready. Skip is a data-defined input gesture (click type, minimum clicks, held keys). The finish packet carries 1 for natural end and 0 for skip. Loading tips come from a tip group chosen by a per-player preference, with an optional pinned first tip and a shuffle of the rest; the loading stage waits for the first tip (and a second when pinned) to load.

data_fields.name: hit_presentation.value
data_fields.unit: damage number from the server event

keep: Ready gate: do not start an intro until its music, entities and objects are loaded
Time-sorted cursor for scripted timeline actions
Skip gesture as data, not code
Finish flag sent back to the server so it knows the intro ended or was skipped
Pinned first tip so the loading card is never empty
Scripted hit shows the number from the real server event
change: Offsets in ms as data, not frame counts in code
Skip is one tap by default
No idle-kill logic in the presentation layer; the server owns connection health
Our tip text and art, no donor text or assets

onboarding.first_90_seconds: Loading screen with a bar and one tip line, then login, then any server-started intro. Nothing before control except the loading screen and the intro.
onboarding.first_fight_staging: A scripted hit can be shown on a cutscene entity at a timed point. Winnability is not in the client half.
onboarding.first_reward_loot_level: Not in the client half (not read).
onboarding.first_hub_services: A cutscene area builds a walk packet and sets the minimap flag; services not in the client half (not read).
onboarding.first_meaningful_choice: Not in the client half (not read).
onboarding.pull_forward_5_10_30: Not in the client half (not read).
onboarding.tutorial_style: No tutorial code in the client half; the skip is data-defined; text length not read.
onboarding.drop_off_risks: Intro can stay in loading state if an asset never reports ready (no timeout seen in lines read). Avoids: one-tap skip; pinned first tip.
onboarding.could_be_ours: Skippable ring walk-in with a stinger and a server-taken first hit number, plus a pinned-first loading card.

look_test: On the gladiator ring: a 4-second walk-in with camera push-in, one music stinger at about 1.2 s, the first hit number at about 2.4 s from a real server event, any tap skips. Plus a loading card with three tips, one pinned, one line each. Judge: number readable at 375 wide, one tap skips, stinger lands on the hit, tip clear of the bar.
